title: Etched raises $700M, reaching $21B valuation a month after its last round
reason: Published. Full multi-agent protocol run (fresh verifier + fresh adversarial falsifier, concurrent given cycle time budget). Both independently confirmed: (1) Etched raised $700M at a $21B valuation, announced 18 August 2026 -- Tier-0 company statement (GlobeNewswire release, on-record Jane Street quote embedded) plus two independently-reporting Tier-2 outlets (TechCrunch with its own co-founder interview, Reuters with its own bylined report and an independent analyst quote) -- clears the business-claim >=2-independent-source bar comfortably, well past wire-exclusive relay status.
